verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distribution, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never describes a first-party mechanism for versioning, diffing, or reverting automations. The closest items are system-wide snapshots on updates (omarchy-snapshot create) and bundled Lazygit; these are adjacent whole-system rollback and a general git tool, not automation-specific version control or review, so they earn no credit.
